channel.title: Mellow Machines Lab — Technical guides
channel.description: Original guides for agent harnesses, System One Models, coding companions and ESP32 hardware.

item.title: Agent harness design for fast, expressive feedback
item.description: How MellowHarness combines a System One decision loop, bounded action choices, immediate rules and a shared JSONL event log for AI hardware and applications.

item.title: System One Models: Jev and typed decision interfaces
item.description: A source-backed guide to Jev, OpenAI Decisions API and the open-source Laya project. Typed action choices, integration status and evaluation boundaries.

item.title: Build an expressive companion for Claude Code and Codex
item.description: Connect coding-agent hooks to Buddygotchi’s state, mood and character. MellowHarness architecture, public build requirements and scripted-demo boundaries.

item.title: Jev decision-pass latency: a 105-pass application log
item.description: An audited historical Jev sample: 227 ms median across 105 decision passes. Full distribution, sanitized data and limits of the measurement.

item.title: Try MellowHarness without a model API key
item.description: Run a scripted agent loop on your Mac: send build events, apply immediate rules and inspect the shared log. No model key or ESP32 hardware required.

item.title: Build an ESP32 AI companion with a host-side agent harness
item.description: Connect an ESP32 display to a Mac host with Buddygotchi and MellowHarness. Hardware requirements, host setup and the boundary between feedback and model choices.

item.title: Build Buddygotchi: from harness to animation to hardware
item.description: A source-backed ESP32 companion tutorial: MellowHarness, Jev mood choices, the public Pixel animation pack, CYD parts, firmware and the Mac host.

item.title: ESP32 parts list for a Buddygotchi build
item.description: The exact CYD board, USB cable, Mac requirements and optional speaker or storage for the public Pixel companion. Includes an AMOLED board comparison and source links.
